news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Pankaj Yadav is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2025. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Pearl Green Clubs and Resorts Limited Appoints Mohit Sunil Nagdev as Additional Director (Non-Executive Non-Independent Director), Effective February 26, 2026
news.body: Pearl Green Clubs and Resorts Limited appointed Mr. Mohit Sunil Nagdev as Additional Director (Non-Executive Non-Independent Director) of the Company effective from February 26, 2026, who will hold office up to the ensuing General Meeting. He is a Cost and Management Accountant (CMA). Treasurer – Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI), Baroda Chapter. He is having professional expertise in capital restructuring, and corporate finance advisory. He actively works with management teams to enhance capital efficiency, financial sustainability and long-term enterprise value through structured and compliant capital frameworks. news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.6% average weekly change).
